findings.evidence: Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/Basic.lean:581 explicitly distinguishes `I.Boundaryless` from the more general `BoundarylessManifold`, while ExtChartAt.lean:644 proves `interior_extChartAt_target_nonempty` without either assumption, providing the open positive-measure subset needed by the argument.
findings.fix: Remove the model-level assumption (or at least replace it with manifold-level boundarylessness); prove positivity using the nonempty open set `interior (extChartAt I α).target` and `interior_extChartAt_target_nonempty`.
findings.issue: `riemannianTotalVolume_pos` assumes `[I.Boundaryless]`, which is strictly stronger than the relevant `[BoundarylessManifold I M]`; the same overrestriction occurs in `chartRiemannianVolume_pos` at Measure.lean:141.

summary: The positivity theorem uses boundarylessness of the model rather than the manifold, so it does not establish the claimed result for every closed manifold.
